liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Don't Laugh (I Love You) (switch, Dave Deiewitz on Guitar)** (2 other sources): Marked as a switch, with Dave Dreiwitz taking guitar; Marked as a switch, with Dave Dreiwitz on guitar [1][2]
- **Pollo Asado (chips and peppers thrown into crowd by Gene)** (1 other source): Gene threw chips, and possibly some peppers, into the crowd [3]

## Setlist highlights

- **It's Going to Be A Long Night**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **The Stallion (Pt 1)**: back after 81 archived shows (2983 days) [8]
- **Pollo Asado (chips and peppers thrown into crowd by Gene)**: rare: 13 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **Ween2016-09-15.RoyWilkinsStPaulBerlinerCardioid** (recommended): audience recording; 31 songs; 147 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds the audience recording sounds great for a taping made at Roy Wilkins; Uploader says Roy Wilkins Auditorium is acoustically difficult [1][6]
- **Ween2016-09-15.RoyWilkinsStPaulSchoepsMK41**: audience recording; 30 songs; 147 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer says the room's sound is mediocre, but the acoustic numbers come across well and fitting crowd noise makes it easy listening; Reviewer says the recording is clearer than what they heard live and captures the show's mood; they also like the taper's other version; Uploader says they could do little about the hall's sound, calling it primitive [2][5][7]
- **ween2016-09-15.akg414.flac24**: source not stated; 31 songs; 147 min [3]
- **ween2016-09-15.akg414.flac16**: source not stated; 31 songs; 147 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer arrived late and missed the Paul Bunyan shirt in Large, so bought the black tour shirt [6]
- The venue was a packed house for this show [7]
- Dave Dreiwitz played bass except where noted; Gene Ween played guitar, harmonica and vocals [3]

## Tapers and lineage

- **Ween2016-09-15.RoyWilkinsStPaulBerlinerCardioid**: taped by Cliff Morse; transferred by Cliff Morse; source: AUD>SDHC Flash [1]. Also: Berliner CM33 cardioid mics into Tascam DR60d at 24-bit/48kHz, resampled to 16-bit/44.1kHz in Soundforge; taped and transferred by Cliff Morse [1]
- **Ween2016-09-15.RoyWilkinsStPaulSchoepsMK41**: taped by Cliff Morse; transferred by Cliff Morse; source: AUD>SDHC Flash [2]. Also: Schoeps MK41 hypercardioid mics through Naiant Tinybox into Tascam DR60d, 24-bit/48kHz, resampled to 16-bit/44.1kHz; taped and transferred by Cliff Morse [2]
- **ween2016-09-15.akg414.flac24**: taped by Dean Lambrecht; transferred by Dean Lambrecht; source: akg414 (hypercardioids) din/nos 8’ ROC, 100' from stage, stand 12’^ > Hi Ho Silver xlr cables > Edirol R4 (Oade T mod) at 24/44 [3]
- **ween2016-09-15.akg414.flac16**: taped by Dean Lambrecht; transferred by Dean Lambrecht; source: akg414 (hypercardioids) din/nos 8’ ROC, 100' from stage, stand 12’^ > Hi Ho Silver xlr cables > Edirol R4 (Oade T mod) at 24/44 [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by First Avenue: [Ween ★ Roy Wilkins Auditorium - First Avenue](https://first-avenue.com/event/ween/) [9]
